description: Mass edit cells in column venue

expression:
jython:import re
def standardize_venue(value):
    value = re.sub(r'[.;,!?]', '', value).lower()
    if len(value) > 3:
        return value.strip()
    else:
        return None

data = [
    "RESTAURANT",
    "COMMERCIAL",
    "PATR;",
    "Commercial",
    "RESTAURANT",
    "SOC;.?",
    "COMMERCIAL",
    "COMMERCIAL",
    "COMMERCIAL",
    "POL;",
    "SS; FOR",
    "Professional",
    "COMMERCIAL",
    "COMMERCIAL",
    "COMMERCIAL",
    "RESTAURANT.?"
]

venues = [standardize_venue(value) for value in data if value is not None]
page_counts = {venue: data.count(venue) for venue in venues}

exceeding_venues = [venue for venue, count in page_counts.items() if count > 10]
print(exceeding_venues)
